Chinchou

Water Electric

Johto · Generation 2

Chinchou is a Water/Electric-type Angler Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 12 kg. It evolves into Lanturn. Its highest base stat is HP (75), with a base stat total of 330.
